chapter: Early bands and the road to New York
title: Edward Bolton and Sonny Stitt
summary: Jones thinks Bolton was Sonny Stitt's father; Stitt never worked in those bands; a taped message from Stitt.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Do you have any recollection of Edward Bolton?

Oh, I think that was Sonny Stitt’s father if I’m not mistaken. I believe that was Professor Bolton. I’ve never met him but I’ve heard Sonny talk about him. I believe that was his name if I’m not mistaken. I’m not sure.
Did Stitt go by that name?
Sonny Stitt is the only name I’ve heard him go by.
Do you have a recollection of him from the period you were doing the territory bands and all that?
No. Sonny Stitt never worked with us in those bands. When I heard Sonny Stitt, I believe he did one engagement and –

He did it on tape. He put it on, what do you call it? It was on one of those tapes that could be transferred to a computer. He said, as he put it on paper, "it would be this thick." It was not practical. He sent me one, a while ago, it was this thick. I still have it though.
